title: e2e since-last-run-1
description: The record `e2e run --since-last-run` keeps in `<output>/since-last-run.json`: every test that has passed, with the working tree it passed against. Advisory: a runner that finds any other document reads no record and runs every test.

configDigest.description: The digest of the config whose runs settled the tests, as a report's run.project.configDigest. A run under another config reads no record.

settled.description: The settled tests, keyed by result id: the digest of a test, a target, and an agent.

testId.description: The id of the test, which a later run drops the entry by once collection no longer finds it.

tree.description: The git tree of the working tree the test last passed against, or was last judged unaffected up to: every tracked and untracked file git does not ignore, without the output and cache directories.

tracked.description: The git tree of the tracked files alone in that working tree: what a test filter diffs.
